_doc: M7c far plate (human interventions 19 and 22; decisions 32, 35+): far plate 1 (plate_city_s42, M7b) extended sideways with FLUX.2 [dev] outpainting so the park's wides and O20e's truck stay inside it, the far sides grown from plates 2-3 (plate_ridges_s41/s42) as the far tree lines; then O22d, the same plate animated with LTX-2.3 image-to-video. scripts/m7c_plate.py. Prompt = subject + ', ' + style. FLUX.2 [dev] has no negative prompt, so the constraints are written into the style as 'no ...' (as M4 and M7b). Model, sampler and steps as M4 and M7b (config/m4_stills.json, config/m7b_park_concepts.json). Seeds from config/seeds.json m7c_plate_extend and m7c_o22d.
_layout: Panorama columns (px): L2 [0,1280), L1 [1280,2560), the original plate [2560,5120), R1 [5120,6400), R2 [6400,7680). Each pass is a 2560x1440 canvas: 1280 px of the panorama so far and 1280 px to fill. Mask (differential diffusion: the value is the local denoise strength): 1 on the whole new part, ramping to 0 over 'ramp' px into the known part (the seam is blended over the same ramp in the panorama); L2/R2 start from the ridges plate's half next to the city (init_strength on it, 1 over the 'band' px next to the junction). Run 4 of L2/R2 (production log 46): band 520 px with a 200 px soft edge (run 3's 256/64 left a hard vertical edge where the ridges' forest began), init_strength 0.9, and regen_rows: the ridges plates' far town (slab blocks) regenerated at full strength over those rows (M7b took the ridges plates for their tree lines only).
style: matte painting background plate, photorealistic, overcast, soft flat grey light, layered atmospheric fog, high detail, sharp, no foreground objects, no people, no faces, no text, no letters or numbers, no signs, no logos, no landmarks, no observation towers, every building a generic anonymous office or apartment block, no boats, no ships, no ferries, no water, no lake, no bay, no river, no sea

o22d._doc: O22d (brief: 'fog drifting over the skyline'; human interventions 19: the same plate animated by image-to-video). The input is a crop of the original plate (no extension in it) at LTX's 1280x704 aspect; ComfyUI template video_ltx2_3_i2v as M4's clips (scripts/clips.py), 24 fps, 5 s for the 4.70 s shot; prompt = motion + '. ' + style.
o22d.motion: A locked-off static tripod shot from a hilltop of a distant generic city in fog: the framing never moves, no zoom, no push-in, no pan, no tilt. Thin layers of fog drift slowly sideways across the towers and the wooded hills below them, and the low cloud base slides slowly over the tops of the tallest towers. The buildings and the trees keep their exact shapes. Nothing else moves: no people, no birds, no vehicles, no lights switching on
o22d.style: Realistic film footage, overcast afternoon, soft flat grey daylight, subtle 35mm film grain, a completely static locked-off camera, every building keeps its exact shape, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no boats, no ships, no ferries, no water
